hero.subtitle: Shared flight and transport | Guide | Workshop and traveler kit

description.title: Discover Teotihuacán beyond the flight
description.paragraph: Traveler combines a shared flight and shared round-trip transport with a full breakfast, archaeological site admission and a bilingual guide. A crafts and traditional drinks workshop, traveler kit or souvenir, coffee break, insurance, sparkling wine toast and certificate are included. Ask about pricing and the number of guests covered before booking.

notes: Confirm availability, timing, the meeting point and your total before booking.
Flight duration, route and activity order are confirmed according to weather and operating conditions.
Extras are quoted separately; confirm their scope, price and availability.
Confirm how many guests the package includes, the booking minimum and charges for additional passengers or companions.
Private flight and transport upgrades are quoted separately.
If you upgrade to a private flight, confirm the private guide arrangement too.
